recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中漿細胞明顯增加，許多漿細胞核上重疊有 1–4 個淡藍、圓形且邊界清楚的核內包涵體（Dutcher bodies），外觀像核內空泡，符合漿細胞骨髓瘤。
features: Hypercellular aspirate with many plasma cells admixed with maturing granulocytes
Plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, deeply basophilic cytoplasm, and perinuclear hof
Multiple round, pale blue, sharply outlined intranuclear inclusions (Dutcher bodies) overlying nuclei in numerous plasma cells
Some plasma cells large with more open chromatin and occasional binucleation
Background fat vacuoles and scattered mature neutrophils and erythroid cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular and shows a marked increase in plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, deeply basophilic cytoplasm, and perinuclear clearing, some of which are enlarged with more open chromatin. Many plasma cells contain one to several round, pale blue, well-circumscribed intranuclear inclusions consistent with Dutcher bodies (cytoplasmic immunoglobulin invaginated into the nucleus). Residual granulocytic and erythroid precursors are present. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma; plasma cell percentage should be quantified and clonality confirmed by CD138 with kappa/lambda staining or flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: LPL also shows Dutcher bodies but has a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes, and plasma cells with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P, rather than a predominant plasma cell infiltrate.
Reactive plasma cells are mature, usually under 10%, perivascular in distribution, polytypic, and rarely contain Dutcher bodies.
Russell bodies are cytoplasmic grape-like immunoglobulin globules that fill the cytoplasm rather than inclusions superimposed on the nucleus.
